result:
I'm confirming which files call `isEnabled()` directly and which only reach it through a wrapper.

The predicate is `isEnabled(flag, ctx)`, defined in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`. I counted files that import it and call it in their own code. I left out these:
- **Files that only use the precomputed snapshot:** `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx`, `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/_lib/tenant-context.ts` and `src/components/domain/flags/feature-flag-provider.tsx`. They call `snapshotFlags()` and never call `isEnabled()` themselves.
- **Files that go through the `readFlag()` wrapper:** `src/components/domain/flags/feature-gate.tsx` and `src/hooks/use-feature-flag.ts`. Their header comments mention `isEnabled`, but they only call `readFlag()` in `src/hooks/flag-context.ts`, which does call it directly and so is on the list.
- **The defining file:** `src/lib/feature-flags.ts` calls `isEnabled()` inside its own `snapshotFlags()` and `assertEnabled()`, but I didn't count the module as a caller of itself.
- **Tests:** `tests/lib/feature-flags.test.ts` calls it directly, but I read "source file" as code under `src/`.

ANSWER: src/app/api/search/route.ts, src/app/api/export/activity/route.ts, src/app/api/export/issues/route.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/@panel/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/flags/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/webhooks/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/notifications/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/activity/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/board/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/search/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/_components/dashboard-shell.tsx, src/config/nav.ts, src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts, src/server/jobs/digest-email-job.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/digest-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/components/domain/board/kanban-board.tsx, src/components/domain/notification/notification-preferences-form.tsx, src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx, src/components/domain/search/search-dialog.tsx, src/components/domain/nav/app-sidebar.tsx, src/components/domain/nav/top-bar.tsx, src/hooks/flag-context.ts, src/hooks/use-command-palette.ts, src/hooks/command-groups.ts, src/actions/flags/toggle-flag.ts, src/actions/search/search.ts, src/actions/webhooks/create-webhook.ts, src/actions/issues/move-issue.ts, src/actions/notifications/update-preferences.ts
